svg.text: Gate 6 no orphan numbers: every number in the answer traces to a run

text.tspan: 1 ask → 2 the LLM calls a tool (gate 1 checks the arguments) → 3 deterministic models run → 4 gates 2-5 check every run; failures go back to the LLM → 5 the answer is checked by gate 6 before you see it
